fine_tag_feature = features["fine_ner_tags"].feature
label_names = fine_tag_feature.names
print(f"Total label names: {len(label_names)}")
print("Labels:", label_names)

# Count per-type instances in test set (span-level)
type_counter = Counter()
for example in ds["test"]:
    tags = example["fine_ner_tags"]
    i = 0
    while i < len(tags):
        tag_id = tags[i]
        if tag_id != 0:  # Not O
            tag_name = label_names[tag_id]
            # Remove B- or I- prefix to get type name
            if tag_name.startswith("B-"):
                entity_type = tag_name[2:]
                type_counter[entity_type] += 1
                # Skip I- tags of the same entity
                i += 1
                while i < len(tags) and tags[i] != 0 and label_names[tags[i]].startswith("I-"):
                    i += 1
                continue
        i += 1

# Build stats

for t, c in type_counter.items():

insufficient = sorted([t for t, info in per_type.items() if not info["sufficient"]])

    "per_type": {t: per_type[t] for t in type_list},
